evals.prompt: A card hover adds an accent outline and hardcoded black shadow while focus-visible already uses the same accent outline. Review the CSS change.
evals.expected_output: The review rejects the shadow and preserves distinct hover and focus language in both color schemes.
expectations: Rejects hardcoded black component color in favor of tokens or removal.
Keeps card hover to the documented accent border and 2px lift.
Requires hover, focus, and active to be compared together in light and dark schemes.

evals.prompt: Theme-aware SVG images follow prefers-color-scheme, but the site's manual data-theme toggle does not change them. Review the proposed fix.
evals.expected_output: The review sets the matching color-scheme on manual theme roots so embedded SVG media queries receive the selected scheme.
expectations: Requires html[data-theme] overrides to set a matching color-scheme.
Avoids duplicating every SVG solely to support the manual theme.
Requires rendered light and dark verification.
